name: Scan code - Barcode
description: Lets users scan information from a barcode image.
project_description:
Features 
 This module define extention for field form text widget.

This extension allow the site builder to add possibility to scan barcodes using camera.

 Project is based on https://www.drupal.org/project/commerce_pos - submodule barcode_scanning .

 Requirements 
 JS Libraries:

 
 https://github.com/ericblade/quagga2 (Quagga2) 
 https://webrtc.github.io/adapter/adapter-latest.js 
 
 Installation 
 Using standard module installation via composer.

All libraries will be insalled automatically.

 Post-Installation 
 More information in README.md
